help.title: How to play
help.classicBody: Guess today's NPC by attributes. After each try, columns show what matches and what doesn't fit.
help.manhuntFiction: A purse for informants: 14 ore nuggets. The less you spend catching the fugitive, the more experience you earn. Wrong accusations cost too.
help.manhuntTip1: Hints on the wanted poster cost ore nuggets.
help.manhuntTip2: A wrong accusation costs one ore nugget.
help.manhuntTip3: The more nuggets you keep, the more experience you earn.
help.quoteBody: Read the dialogue exchange and name the NPC who said these words. Hints appear after several wrong tries.
help.mapBody: Click on the map where the named NPC stands. After each try you'll see the distance in meters from the correct point.
help.cardBody: Guess the NPC from a character card. Before solving, only attributes, talents and level are visible.
help.legendArrows: Only explicit fields from NPC scripts are compared.

authErrors.invalid_state: Google sign-in was interrupted — try again.
authErrors.google_failed: Google rejected sign-in. Check OAuth configuration.
authErrors.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Anonymous play still works.
authErrors.not_configured: Google sign-in is not configured in this environment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountBody: Google sign-in protects your streak across devices. Full game works without an account.
settings.emailOptIn: I want to receive email from KOLONIA (news).
settings.pushOptIn: Remind me daily about the new puzzle.
settings.pushTwaBlocked: No system prompt appeared. Uninstall the KOLONIA app, clear Chrome data for kolonia.app, reinstall, and try again. Or: Settings → Apps → KOLONIA → Notifications → Allow.
settings.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked. Android: Settings → Apps → KOLONIA → Notifications → Allow. Chrome: lock icon → Notifications.
settings.pushDismissed: Permission was not confirmed. Toggle again to see the system prompt.

ui.onboardingTitle: Which camp do you belong to?
ui.onboardingBody: Your choice affects theming and camp rivalry. The daily puzzle stays the same for everyone.

columnHints.guild: The character's guild (Guard, Ore Baron, Digger, etc.). Green = same guild as today's character—not confirmation you guessed the role.
columnHints.guildFamily: Camp or major faction (Old Camp, New Camp, Brotherhood…). Green = same camp as today's character.
columnHints.location: Where the character is usually found. Green = same location.
columnHints.teacher: What the character teaches. Green = same category as today's character.
columnHints.trade: What the character trades. Green = same category as today's character.

manhunt.wantedFlavor: Wanted for desertion and violation of camp law. A reward for whoever brings them to the Guards.
manhunt.brokeBody: You spent all your ore. Without nuggets you can't name the fugitive. Unfortunately, {name} was not captured.
